task.blocked: Blocked: a subtask it waits for did not finish

weeklySpend.empty: No spend recorded in the last 8 weeks.

code.truncated: The diff is too long to show completely.
code.none: No code has been delivered yet. The employee calls git_push when its work is committed.
code.hooksDisabled: git hooks are disabled for every platform-run git command
code.noTest: No test command was run in this task yet.
code.approved: Approved: the platform is pushing the approved commit
code.discardConfirm: Discard this work? Pending approvals expire and the workspace will be deleted (the deliverables stay).
code.nothingPending: Nothing is waiting for approval: the employee has not proposed a push yet, or it was already decided.
code.feedbackPlaceholder: What should change? The employee continues in the same session and workspace.
code.changesRequested: Changes requested: the employee will continue
code.previewPending: A preview of this branch is waiting for approval.
code.releasePending: A release of this work to live is waiting for the Owner's approval.

merge.title: Merge into {base}
merge.unmerged: The latest version of this work is not in {base} yet. Merge it so a deploy of {base} and the next task include it.
merge.notDone: Can be merged into {base} once the task is done.
merge.confirm: Merge the latest version of this work into {base} and push it? The platform fast-forwards or writes a merge commit; it never force-pushes.
merge.skipConfirm: Leave this version out of {base}? It stops showing as waiting; you can still merge it later.
merge.merging: Merging: the platform is pushing to the repository
merge.skippedToast: Left out of the default branch
merge.detected: This work is already in {base} (merged outside Workforce OS).
merge.skipped: Left out of {base}: this version was not merged.
merge.conflicts: Conflicts with {base} in these files; nothing was merged:
merge.failed: The merge failed; nothing was changed.
merge.askFix: Ask the employee to bring it up to date
merge.fixRequested: Sent back: the employee merges the latest default branch and proposes the push again
merge.adminOnly: An Admin or the Owner merges it.

incident.handling: Incident handed to the team lead

named.team_review_unresolved: Review ended with a failed subtask unresolved
named.run_out_of_memory: Stopped: the sandbox ran out of memory
named.run_time_limit: Stopped: the task's sandbox time is used up
named.workspace_yielded: Handed the sandbox to a waiting task
named.run_tools_unavailable: Stopped: the platform tools were unavailable

stoppedHint.stalled: No progress was reported for too long, so the run was stopped.
stoppedHint.loop: The same tool call kept repeating, so the run was stopped.
